title: Joy Engine configuration
description: Workspace editor and project production availability stored in a .joyconfig document.

projects.description: Production build, capture, and deployment overrides keyed by workspace-relative project directory. Unlisted projects remain enabled. Development and direct project commands remain available; editor availability belongs in editors.

editors.description: Production availability overrides. Development enables all editors; enabling Joy Editor also enables both tool editors.

formLab.description: Legacy spelling of formEditor; ignored when formEditor is present.

particleLab.description: Legacy spelling of joyfxEditor; ignored when joyfxEditor is present.

productionEnabled.description: Include this project in root production builds, release captures, and the deployed site. False also removes stale workspace output during root builds.
Whether this editor is included in production builds and previews.
